content:
Hi all — first-time contributor here! I'm an amateur mathematician with a curiosity emphasis on transcendental numbers.

I noticed LiouvilleWith.lean's module doc says the reverse implication for 1 < p ≤ 2 (irrational ⟹ LiouvilleWith p) "follows from approximations by continued fractions and is not formalized yet." (https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/master/Mathlib/NumberTheory/Transcendental/Liouville/LiouvilleWith.lean)

I have a proof that works via a different route than continued fractions — it compiles clean against current Mathlib. Happy to open a PR if this is actually still open territory.

Looking forward to meeting the community.
